target_year_over_year_context.explanation: The 2024 disclosure reports the resolution of the IRS audit for fiscal years 2018 and 2019 in Q3 FY2024, resulting in a $145 million non-cash benefit. The 2023 records in Item 7 indicate that the company was *currently under examination* for those same fiscal years (D085) and could not estimate timing. There was no prior 2023 disclosure of a *resolution* or final settlement for this specific audit; thus, the 2024 event is a new disclosure with no direct 2023 counterpart in the provided records.

comparisons.peer_topic: Income Tax Provision and Effective Rate
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD recorded an income tax provision of $381 million in 2024 with a 19% effective tax rate, compared to a $346 million benefit and (68%) rate in 2023. The 2024 provision increase was driven by higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures discuss income tax provisions and effective rates in the context of discrete items or specific events impacting the 2024 fiscal year, but they focus on different drivers. NVDA reports a $145 million non-cash net benefit specifically from the resolution of an IRS audit for prior years (2018-2019), which partially offset an increase in its effective tax rate. In contrast, AMD reports a $381 million income tax provision driven primarily by higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction, rather than an audit resolution. While both companies disclose the impact of discrete tax events on their 2024 effective tax rates, the nature of the events (audit settlement vs. integration transaction) and the resulting financial impact (benefit vs. provision) differ materially.

sentences.text: During the third quarter of fiscal year 2024, the Internal Revenue Service, or IRS, audit of our federal income tax returns for fiscal years 2018 and 2019 was resolved.
We recognized a non-cash net benefit of $145 million, related to this IRS audit resolution, for effectively settled positions.

This benefit consists of a reduction in unrecognized tax benefits of $236 million and related accrued interest of $17 million, net of federal benefit, partially offset by additional cash tax payments and reductions in tax attribute carryforwards of $108 million.
We recorded an income tax provision of $381 million in 2024 and an income tax benefit of $346 million in 2023, representing effective tax rates of 19% and (68%), respectively.
The increase in income tax provision in 2024 was primarily due to higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction.
